fields.System.Title: RPL-304 — Handle a partial replenishment
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment operator, I want to move less than the task asked for when that is all
there is, so that a partial refill is recorded properly instead of being abandoned.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the source holds less than the task quantity, then I can confirm the lesser
  • amount with a reason.
  • - Given a partial confirmation, then the movement records what actually moved and the
  • task closes.
  • - Given the location is still below minimum after the partial, then a new task is
  • created on the next evaluation — not immediately, to avoid a loop.
  • - Given the destination filled before the full quantity was moved, then the remainder
  • stays at the source and the task closes with a capacity reason.
  • - Given partial completions, then they are reportable, since a high rate indicates
  • rules or capacities are wrong.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | replen_task, stock_movement |
| Risks | Immediate re-trigger causing a loop ([doc 09 §7.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
